basic_details.short_information: The Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Bhubaneswar under Prasar Bharati (Doordarshan News) is forming panels of casual assignees in seven categories: News Reader (Odia), Editorial Assistant, Copy Editor, News Reporter/ Assembly Reporter, Assistant Website Editor, Video Editor and Resource Person. Each category pays between Rs 1500 and Rs 2400 per day per shift, as per the Doordarshan fee structure for casual assignees. The work is purely casual and carries no claim to regularisation. how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application format (Annexure-II), attached to the notice. Send it with self-attested copies of all relevant documents, including educational qualification certificates, proof of age, experience certificates and any other supporting documents. Applications must be sent by either Speed Post or email, and must reach RNU, DDK Bhubaneswar within 21 days from the date of publication of the NIA in the Vacancy section of the Prasar Bharati website. A separate application form is needed for each category applied for.
Compile the filled-in Annexure-II form and all required self-attested documents into a single PDF file.
Write the subject line as: "Application for Empanelment of _____ (Name of the Category of Casual Assignees being applied for)."
Make sure every document in the checklist is attached. Incomplete applications or applications without the required documents are liable to be rejected.
Put the Annexure-II form and all required self-attested documents in one single envelope.
Write on the envelope: "Application for Empanelment of _____ (Name of the Category of Casual Assignees being applied for)."
Send it by Speed Post to: Head, Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Post - Sainik School, Bhubaneswar, PIN 751005.

Applications submitted by hand, through courier or by any mode other than email or Speed Post will not be accepted. A separate detailed CV may also be submitted along with Annexure-II, but the Annexure-II form must be submitted without exception.

The Annexure-II form asks for the category (only one per form), personal and address details, mobile number (preferably WhatsApp), email ID, educational and professional or technical qualifications, language proficiency in Odia, Hindi, English and any other language (speaking, writing and computer typing), current employment, prior experience in print, electronic or digital media, and any current casual or contractual work with All India Radio or Doordarshan. It ends with a signed declaration.

Queries about filling the form can be emailed to [email protected] with the subject line "Query on Application Form for Empanelment of Casual Assignees." Applicants may also call 0674–2300800 on working days during office hours.

content_sections.heading: About DDK Bhubaneswar
content_sections.text: Doordarshan Kendra (DDK), Bhubaneswar is a Doordarshan centre under Prasar Bharati, the public broadcaster. Its Regional News Unit (RNU), part of Doordarshan News, issued this notice. The office is at Doordarshan Kendra, Post - Sainik School, Bhubaneswar, PIN 751005. Persons on the panel are engaged for specific assignments at RNU DDK Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.text: The notice lists seven categories of casual assignees. It does not give the number of persons to be empanelled in any category.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The rates in the vacancy table follow the prevailing Doordarshan fee structure applicable to casual assignees and are subject to revision as notified from time to time. The remuneration is non-negotiable and is paid strictly according to the prevailing Doordarshan News fee structure for casual assignees engaged in the RNU. Empanelled persons are engaged purely on a casual basis for specific assignments at RNU DDK Bhubaneswar. Being on the panel does not guarantee assignments. Assignments are given on an "as and when required" basis, and candidates cannot demand them as a right. Empanelled candidates are ordinarily given a maximum of seven (7) assignments per month. Empanelled persons have no claim, implicit or explicit, for absorption or regularisation in RNU DDK Bhubaneswar/Prasar Bharati, and are not entitled to any pensionary benefits. The panel is valid for two years, after which it will stand terminated unless extended by the Director General, DD News.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: RNU, DDK Bhubaneswar/Prasar Bharati reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on relevant age, education, experience and other criteria. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for skill tests/auditions/interviews. The skill tests may be of any kind, including written, interview, computer-based test, test through video conferencing, audition or screen test. They assess the skills, suitability and personality of shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to shortlisted candidates called for the skill tests, audition or personality test. Communication comes from [email protected] , so candidates should keep checking their inbox and spam/junk folders.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DDK Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications sent by Speed Post or email must reach RNU, DDK Bhubaneswar within 21 days from the date of publication of the NIA in the Vacancy section of the Prasar Bharati website.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: All categories except Video Editor need a Degree from a recognized University, with extra requirements for each category. Video Editor needs 10+2, a Degree / Diploma in Film and video editing and two years' experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21-40 years for News Reader (Odia), 25-50 years for Editorial Assistant and 21-50 years for the other five categories.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the remuneration?
faq.answer: Remuneration ranges from Rs 1500 to Rs 2400 per day per shift, depending on the category. For example, Assistant Website Editor gets Rs 2100/- per day per shift, and Copy Editor gets Rs 1500.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no application fee for any of the casual assignee positions.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-II form and send it with self-attested documents by email to [email protected] as a single PDF. Alternatively, send it by Speed Post to Head, Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Post - Sainik School, Bhubaneswar, PIN 751005.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on age, education, experience and other criteria. Shortlisted candidates are then called for skill tests, auditions or interviews, which may be written, computer-based, by video conferencing, audition or screen test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Empanelled persons are engaged purely on a casual basis and have no claim for absorption or regularisation. The panel is valid for two years unless extended by the Director General, DD News.

faq.question: Q9. How many assignments will an empanelled candidate get?
faq.answer: Empanelled candidates are ordinarily given a maximum of seven (7) assignments per month, on an "as and when required" basis. Being on the panel does not guarantee any assignments.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one category?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form must be submitted for each category of casual assignee.
